Produce ONE isolated autumn-state sprite of EXACTLY the same tree, on true alpha transparency. Change green foliage only to warm orange, golden yellow, and gentle rust red; keep trunk and root structure identical and neutral lighting equally bright. Keep the green ground patch under its roots exactly as in the reference, since this is part of the existing tree sprite. No new fallen leaves outside that footprint, no snow, no scene, no text, no border, no sprite sheet, no blur or extra glowing effects. This must align with the reference when seasons switch. One sprite filling most of canvas, generous transparent margin, no clipped pixels.
